queries:
WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram,
    AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS p
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
  WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram,
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM site_averages
GROUP BY entrystat

WITH site_averages AS (
    SELECT
        s.zoneregistry,
        s.entrystat,
        AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram,
        AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
    FROM scanprocessing AS p
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
    WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram,
    AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM site_averages
GROUP BY entrystat;

SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_memusagegb) AS avg_memusagegb
FROM (
    SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat,
           AVG(p.memusagegb) AS site_avg_memusagegb
    FROM scanprocessing AS p
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
    WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8
      AND s.entrystat IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
GROUP BY entrystat;

WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_memusagegb
  FROM scanprocessing AS p
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
    AND s.entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_memusagegb) AS avg_memusagegb
FROM site_averages
GROUP BY entrystat
